help.stdout:
usage: gnd install [-h] [--claude] [--codex] [--global | --project]
                   [--symlink] [--force] [--sync]

Place every packaged GND skill into your agent runtime's skills directory.
Copies by default; a second run with no intervening change performs zero
writes, and a file GND did not place is never overwritten without --force.
Text output only: --format json exists so a retry loop can consume VERIFIER
output, and this is a human-operated setup command with no programmatic
consumer, so a machine-readable install report is deliberately not offered
(D-25).

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --claude    target Claude Code's skills directory (default: both runtimes)
  --codex     target Codex CLI's skills directory (default: both runtimes)
  --global    user level (DEFAULT): ~/.claude/skills and $CODEX_HOME/skills
              (~/.codex/skills)
  --project   this project: ./.claude/skills and ./.codex/skills
  --symlink   link skill directories instead of copying — DEVELOPMENT INSTALLS
              ONLY. A tool environment is rebuilt on upgrade and removed on
              uninstall, so a link into one is silently swapped after a same-
              interpreter reinstall and dangles outright after an interpreter-
              version change or an uninstall
  --force     replace unmanaged files that block a write (never touches files
              you edited)
  --sync      ignore the runtime and scope flags; refresh every standard root
              that already carries an install manifest. This is the second
              half of `uv tool upgrade get-nick-done && gnd install --sync`
